title: Sprint 02 - Directive compiler and runtime integration
description: Build pure state-to-directive compiler helpers and integrate directive bundle generation into closeout, summary, gate, doctor, sprint, blocked-state, and workflow-next-step runtime paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Compiler functions emit deterministic directive bundles from trusted runtime state and detect conflicts before command output.
Closeout, cancellation, summary, sprint report, gate closeout, doctor, sync, blocked work, and workflow navigation paths return appropriate directives.
Directive data carries exact work IDs, summary IDs, evidence IDs, verification IDs, commit SHAs, dirty-path notes, next workflows, and blocker diagnostics.
Sprint closeout includes scoped commit evidence or a no-commit reason code.
